purpose: Compare experimental DS4 MXFP4 gate stream GPU results against CPU vec_dot for the same streamed experts and activation rows.
code_changes: Added default-off GGML_MOE_STREAM_COMPARE_CPU_OUT trace support in ggml-cpu.c.
Added GGML_MOE_STREAM_COMPARE_CPU_LIMIT to cap the number of streamed experts recomputed on CPU.
The compare hook runs only when ggml_cuda_moe_stream_one returns done=true, then writes per-expert max/mean absolute and relative error.

run.answer: preferably also as a list of  .    .   .   .   .   .   .   .   .   . ...

conclusion: The DS4 MXFP4 gate stream mismatch is expert/cache/layout specific. Some experts match CPU exactly while others return zero or wrong-sign values, so the next step is to correlate numeric errors with VRAM cache hit/miss, cache slot/source pointer, and DONTNEED behavior before modifying kernels again.
next_steps: Run the same compare with GGML_MOE_STREAM_DONTNEED=0 to rule out source-page discard affecting the CPU reference or later stream state.
Run the same compare with GGML_MOE_VRAM_CACHE_GB=0 to distinguish VRAM cache copy/slot bugs from kernel/input layout bugs.
If cache-disabled still mismatches, instrument source pointer, row stride, and packed block offsets for one failing and one matching expert.
